art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Fiora is an adult Demacian duelist with a precise dark bob, a striking pink-red hair streak, pale eyes, and an aristocratic composed face. Preserve her blue-white tailoring and shoulder armor with a fully covering fitted jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and tall boots. Her slender ornate rapier remains securely sheathed at her side, the guard visible but no blade drawn or fencing posture.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: royal blue, ivory, rose-red accent, silver gray; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
